_comment: Questions for node scripts/assistant-eval.js. 'expect' is what a good answer does; the script checks the mechanical parts (answers_with, same_script, gives_phone, must_not_contain) and a human or grading agent judges the rest. Real salon data as of 2026-10: Signature 90,000₮/60 min, Express 50,000₮/30, Deluxe 130,000₮/75, Back-neck-shoulder 70,000₮/45, Therapeutic body 95,000₮/60, Full body 140,000₮/90; open 10:00–19:00 every day; Khas Munkh center 2nd floor; free cancellation up to 24 h; wallet off = pay at the salon by cash or card. Update the expectations when the owner changes prices.
